scores.claim_text: Microsoft Agreement: $9.7B TCV over ~5 years, signed Nov 2 2025, dedicated GPU services at Childress; zero tranches delivered/accepted as of Mar 31 2026; no Microsoft RPO recognized.
supports: edgar_fts(MSFT cik=0000789019, term='IREN') -> 0 hits
edgar_fts(MSFT cik=0000789019, term='Iris Energy') -> 0 hits
edgar_fts(MSFT cik=0000789019, term='Childress') -> 0 hits
scores.M_check: Counterparty disclosure threshold (Layer 3 Rule 7). A $9.7B contract is multi-$100M-per-year recurring AI hosting capex and is material to Microsoft's data center capex commentary. Microsoft's 10-Ks/10-Qs filed since November 2, 2025 (FY26 Q1 10-Q filed Oct 2025, FY26 Q2 10-Q filed January 2026) should reasonably disclose a customer/supplier of this magnitude in some form -- material commitments, large supplier lists, or capex commentary.
scores.M_value: Microsoft EDGAR filings: 0 mentions of 'IREN', 0 of 'Iris Energy', 0 of 'Childress' as of 2026-05-16. HARD CONTRADICTION per Calibration Heuristic 7.
scores.interpretation: CRITICAL: IREN claims a $9.7B 5-year dedicated GPU services contract with Microsoft, yet zero corroboration in Microsoft's EDGAR filings. Combined with the fact that zero tranches have been delivered/accepted, no Microsoft consideration is in RPO, the related $3.6B GS/JPM financing remains a non-binding commitment letter, and Microsoft contract value is essentially a TCV announcement booked entirely as future opportunity. This is the textbook AI-DC TCV-vs-recognized-revenue conflation pattern flagged by Heuristic 9, AND a counterparty-disclosure failure per Rule 7. Stage ladder: term sheet / definitive agreement signed; no shell built / commissioned / energized / generating revenue for any Microsoft tranche.  [POST-HOC MANUAL: downgraded from RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE to MODERATE — Mixed H7 (MSFT silence — weak: 0.8% of MSFT revenue, below disclosure threshold) + self-disclosed (zero tranches delivered, no MSFT RPO, $7B convertible cadence). Self-disclosed evidence alone supports MODERATE; H7 not strong enough to elevate further.]

scores.claim_text: 4,510MW grid-connected power capacity claim with new 1,600MW Oklahoma site added since FY25 year-end.
supports: edgar_fts(all, term='Iris Energy Oklahoma') -> 0 hits
edgar_fts(all, term='IREN Oklahoma') -> 0 hits
10-Q discloses $112M asset acquisition for Oklahoma land + connection rights, $105.1M of intangible asset for 12-year connection rights with amortization beginning Q4 FY28
scores.M_check: Stage-ladder discipline (Heuristic 3). The 'executed grid connection agreements, letters of agreement or equivalents' headline lumps together executed and LOA-stage interconnections. Oklahoma site connection-right amortization begins Q4 FY28, implying energization is not imminent.
scores.M_value: No third-party EDGAR corroboration of IREN's Oklahoma site (no utility filings, no partner announcements indexed); however the 10-Q financial-statement note showing a $112M asset acquisition with capitalized connection rights is a substantive, auditable disclosure that is internally consistent.
scores.interpretation: The 4,510MW headline conflates: 810MW operating + 75MW Childress Horizon 1 under construction + 1,400MW Sweetwater 1 substation under construction + ~2,225MW that is at LOA / connection-agreement-signed / development stage including the new 1,600MW Oklahoma site whose connection rights amortization doesn't even begin until FY28. Marketing-tier number is real on paper but only ~18% is operating MW today. Score MODERATE per Heuristic 3 (planned vs operational conflation in headline).

10-Q (filed 2026-05-08): zero Microsoft tranches delivered/accepted as of 2026-03-31, so Horizon 1 was NOT energized by end of CY2025 as targeted in the 10-K; Horizons 2-4 are not even under construction
scores.M_check: Stage-ladder discipline (Heuristic 3) + counterparty corroboration (Rule 7) for Microsoft tranche delivery.
scores.M_value: No Microsoft EDGAR mentions of Horizon, Childress, or IREN; IREN's own 10-Q reveals zero accepted tranches under the Microsoft contract.
scores.interpretation: 10-K target was Horizon 1 energization by end of CY2025 to begin AI hosting deliveries. As of the 10-Q reporting date 2026-03-31, no Microsoft tranches have been delivered or accepted — implying the Horizon 1 facility has slipped or is not yet generating Microsoft revenue. The Horizons 2-4 facilities are referenced only as planned in MD&A capex commentary. This is a stage-ladder failure: 'planned/under construction' is being marketed in service of the headline Microsoft contract but commissioning + energization + revenue milestones have not been hit. MODERATE since the company does disclose 'nil tranches' in the RPO footnote (some transparency).

scores.claim_text: ~150,000 NVIDIA GPUs installed or on order as of Mar 31 2026; $3.5B Dell purchase agreements signed Mar 4 2026 for GPUs delivered in H2 CY2026.

edgar_fts(NVDA cik=0001045810, term='Iris Energy') -> 0 hits
Dell purchase agreements are disclosed in IREN's own 10-Q subsequent events; payment terms (30 days post shipment, in installments) are documented
scores.M_check: Vendor disclosure threshold. NVIDIA and Dell rarely disclose individual customers below the major-customer threshold. NVDA's largest customers (hyperscalers) are obfuscated as 'Customer A/B/C' in their 10-K. A $3.5B Dell order is large in absolute terms but small vs Dell ISG annual revenue (~$45B+).
scores.M_value: 0 corroborating hits in NVDA EDGAR for IREN/Iris Energy. Dell-side corroboration was not directly queried by CIK (Dell CIK not in counterparty list) but Dell does not typically name $3.5B customers individually either.
scores.interpretation: 150k GPU and $3.5B Dell purchase claims are not falsifiable via EDGAR counterparty queries (vendor disclosure threshold). The 150k figure is 'installed or on order' — order quantities are commitments, not deliveries. Score UNVERIFIABLE per Heuristic 5/8 (source-jurisdiction mismatch for commercial vendor relationships). No red flag, but no positive corroboration either.

scores.claim_text: Q3 FY26 revenue $144.8M (flat YoY), net loss $(247.8)M, Adj EBITDA $59.5M (down from $83.1M); Microsoft contribution = $0 (nil tranches delivered).
supports: 10-Q internal disclosure: revenue flat YoY at $144.8M; Adj EBITDA declined 28% YoY; net loss expanded 15x YoY
scores.M_check: AI-DC revenue-recognition pattern check (Heuristic 11). Legacy BTC mining revenue is volatile; if AI pivot marketing is loud but recognized revenue is still mostly BTC, score MODERATE.
scores.M_value: Revenue is exactly flat YoY ($144.8M each period) — implying the AI Cloud Services growth offsets BTC declines or vice versa but no net AI lift visible yet. Net loss expanded materially ($(16.1)M → $(247.8)M) likely driven by interest expense from $3.3B of new convertible notes plus operating costs from AI/GPU buildout WITHOUT corresponding AI revenue.
scores.interpretation: Per Heuristic 11, revenue mix has not yet shifted to AI Cloud Services despite the company's pivot narrative and $9.7B Microsoft contract. Headline 'AI Cloud provider' branding is not yet supported by recognized revenue. Quarter shows widening losses and Adj EBITDA contraction. MODERATE — disclosure-quality issue: the gap between marketing tier (AI pivot) and recognized-revenue tier (still flat, mostly BTC) is significant.

scores.claim_text: >$7B fresh capital (debt + equity) raised in <18 months: $3.69B convertibles outstanding at Mar 31 2026 + $3.0B 2031 Convert issued May 14 2026 + $635M ATM equity through Aug 2025.
supports: 10-Q Note 16 (convertibles): five tranches outstanding totaling $3.69B carrying value at 2026-03-31; new $3.0B 1.00% 2031 Convertible Notes closed 2026-05-14 per 8-K accession 0001140361-26-021285
10-K: $635.1M ATM equity issued through Aug 15 2025 (57.5M shares); ~272M ordinary shares outstanding as of Aug 15 2025
scores.M_check: Distress / dilution fingerprint (Heuristic 10). Repeated large convertible issuance + active ATM equity at thin balance sheet is a distress marker.
scores.M_value: Capital raise pace: $440M (Dec 2024) + $550M (Jun 2025) + $1.0B (Oct 2025) + $2.3B (Dec 2025) + $3.0B (May 2026) = $7.3B in convertible debt over 17 months, plus $635M+ ATM equity, plus $3.6B GS/JPM committed (not closed) for Microsoft GPU financing, plus $625M Mirantis acquisition almost entirely in stock, plus EUR 165M Nostrum.
scores.interpretation: Funding cadence is consistent with a company racing to fund a capex commitment that exceeds current cash flow capacity. Capped call + prepaid forward structures on each convertible tranche reduce dilution mechanics but also signal management acutely concerned about share-price-sensitive dilution. Convertible-debt levels ($7.3B principal) now substantially exceed market cap-implied operating cash flow. SEVERE per Heuristic 10 — heavy reliance on convertible debt + dilutive equity is a classic AI-DC pivot funding pattern that becomes acutely problematic if the Microsoft tranches slip, GS/JPM facility doesn't close, or AI Cloud revenue ramp underperforms.

scores.claim_text: Two M&A transactions in the four days immediately preceding the May 11-14 2026 $3B convertible offering: Mirantis ($625M ~90% stock) on May 4 and Ingenostrum/Nostrum Group (~EUR 165M) on May 7.
supports: edgar_fts(all, term='Mirantis IREN') -> 1 hit, only IREN's own 10-Q
edgar_fts(all, term='Ingenostrum') -> 2 hits, both IREN's own filings
scores.M_check: Investment vs operating distinction (Heuristic 4) + counterparty corroboration. Acquisitions targets are private (Mirantis private cloud software co; Ingenostrum private Spanish DC developer) so absence from external EDGAR is expected.
scores.M_value: No external corroboration is achievable for private acquisition targets. Both transactions are disclosed in IREN's own 10-Q subsequent events / Item 5 Other Information.
scores.interpretation: Two acquisitions announced in four days, immediately followed by a $3B convertible raise on May 11-14, suggests a deliberate sequencing of news flow ahead of a capital raise. Mirantis is paid ~90% in IREN stock (price-sensitive), Ingenostrum is 65% cash / 35% stock. The Spanish DC pipeline (490MW) adds to the marketing-tier MW number but is brand new with no operating MW. MODERATE — disclosure-quality issue around the cadence of news flow and capital raise.
